resources.string: Interrupts short-video feeds. Reads nothing else.

Shunya watches for short-video feeds — Reels, Shorts, Spotlight — and interrupts them, both when you arrive and again after you have scrolled for a while.

It can only see the apps that host those feeds. It is never sent anything from your other apps, including banking, messaging and keyboards. Nothing it sees is recorded, and nothing leaves your phone.

The rest of those apps still work normally. Messages, search and your own profile are not touched.
